cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
from cost_scaling import solve_assignment
import networkx as nx
random.seed(42)
for trial in range(200):
 R=random.randrange(1,12);O=random.randrange(1,12)
 # random sparse pairs
 pairs=[];seen=set()
 for _ in range(random.randrange(0,R*O+1)):
  i=random.randrange(R);j=random.randrange(O);c=random.randrange(0,50)
  if (i,j) in seen:continue
  seen.add((i,j));pairs.append((i,j,c))
 flow,dt,rounds=solve_assignment(R,O,pairs,costmax=max([c for _,_,c in pairs] or [0]))
 G=nx.DiGraph();S='S';T='T'
 G.add_node(S,demand=-R);G.add_node(T,demand=R)
 for i in range(R):G.add_edge(S,('r',i),capacity=1,weight=0)
 for j in range(O):G.add_edge(('o',j),T,capacity=1,weight=0)
 for i,j,c in pairs:G.add_edge(('r',i),('o',j),capacity=1,weight=c)
 maxf=nx.maximum_flow_value(G,S,T)
 G.nodes[S]['demand']=-maxf;G.nodes[T]['demand']=maxf
 cost,_=nx.network_simplex(G)
 cmap={(i,j):c for i,j,c in pairs}
 mycost=sum(cmap[(i,j)] for i,j,f in flow)
 if len(flow)!=maxf or mycost!=cost:
  print('MISMATCH',trial,R,O,pairs,'maxf',maxf,'flow',flow,'cost',mycost,cost);break
else:
 print('sparse assignment random OK')
EOF
